notes: Objects of the main model's College of Communication and Media taken into the scripted build from the 20261118i release (objects changed on Joe's box after that release are not in it). as_is: sound and square to the shell: newsroom with its back offices, mezzanine and furniture (kept where the main model has them: the floor signs put the office stack about 2.5 m further east: open question for Joe), south corridor furniture, entrance window wall, arch and doors, porch gable, tower, loading dock, the ID sign's panel and posts. atrium: the atrium, hallway, stair, wood panel wall, glass guards, cube seats, lights, signs, N classroom and 2F lounge, which the main model drew square to the model axes: turned -13.7 deg about the model origin and moved (0.150, -2.764) so they stand square to the shell and the stair centre lands on the floor 1 sign's stair (checked: no moved vertex outside the shell). sign: the ID sign's lettering, text set to the college's name (UNVERIFIED: no photo of the real sign). Left out: east lounge window tables (dV): they stand in the east lounge, partly outside the walls: 14 objects; patches of the main model's cut wall round the dock doors: the scripted wall has openings there: 6 objects; east lounge (dc, fa, el, em, en): its floor 134.85 and ceiling 138.95 cross the scripted floor 1 at 137.40 (open question for Joe): 145 objects; dd_EAST0 basement room under 1020: its ceiling (137.45..137.53) stands above the scripted floor 1 (137.40); the east basement is an open question: 58 objects; replaced by SW_CCOM_F1_slab_north (137.70): 3 objects; replaced by SW_CCOM_lobby_south_wall_white (Joe's photo: white): 1 objects; replaced by SW_CCOM_lobby_walkoff_mat at the doors (after T1 it would lie 2.7 m off): 4 objects. Dropped (not listed): the east band's low roof plates, eaves and facade pieces, the computer lab (its room is an open question; not modelled), the NG connector and link, the dd_SOUTH0 back wall, fill floors, window units, people placeholders. Full study: decisions per object with reasons (agent ccm's report of 2026-11-20).
